scopeQuestion: Does this City GIS publication establish a city-only parcel layer or exact city-bound feature?

evidence.observation: City Open Data describes parcel data as El Paso County land and lots owned/managed by the El Paso Central Appraisal District (EPCAD), with county parcel shapefiles linked at EPCAD.
EPCAD describes its GIS data and shapefiles as El Paso County parcel information and disclaims completeness/update guarantees.
City GIS publishes a Parcels polygon layer; metadata reports EPSG:6578 and safe GIS system OID OBJECTID. This establishes publisher/service, not city-only feature coverage.
City Limits layer geometry was queried at the WUP point with only OBJECTID allowed; the point is inside the municipal city-limit polygon.

scopeConclusion: The City GIS is the immediate publisher; official City Open Data identifies EPCAD as the countywide parcel source/manager. The city-level WUP centroid is inside the municipal limit, and fresh parcel OBJECTID 130036 from the WUP-centered 13-cell qualification contains it. This supports a city-bound local feature, but the full parcel-layer extent/citywide coverage is not established; retain a county-source/city-publisher caveat.
